{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

Resizes every picture in a folder by a percent, in one Run: 50% for half size, 25% for thumbnails. Each picture keeps its own shape, because the Math nodes work it out from each picture's own size. A small, clear example of doing maths in ComfyUI.

 Pick your folder

  1. On Load Images from Folder Pixaroma, click Browse and pick your folder, or paste the folder's path into the box.
  2. Click Pick images, then Select all, or click only the pictures you want. The button shows how many are picked.
  3. Press Run once. Leave the Run count at 1: the node sends every picture through by itself, one after the other.

This workflow opens with no folder picked: choose your own folder, or try it first on the demo folder Products inside the Media Inputs folder that comes with these workflows.

 A folder inside ComfyUI's own input or output folder works straight away. A folder anywhere else works too, but pick it once with Browse: that is how ComfyUI knows you allowed it.

 Pictures go through in name order. Name them 01_, 02_ and so on if the order matters.

 How the maths works

  • Math Expression takes numbers on its inputs a, b, c ... and works out the formula you type. Plug a wire in and a new input appears.
  • Write formulas like a calculator: a * b / 100, a + 1, (a + b) / 2. round() rounds to a whole number; floor(), ceil(), min(), max() and sqrt() work too.
  • It sends the answer as INT (a whole number), FLOAT (with decimals) and BOOL (true or false), so it fits any input.
  • With a folder, the maths runs once PER picture, because each picture comes with its own width and height.

 Other handy formulas: a * 1080 / b for the height that keeps a picture's shape at 1080 wide (a = height, b = width), or a - a % 16 to round a size down to a multiple of 16.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Folder not approved Save to your own folder Nodes look different from the video

{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Load Images from Folder Pixaroma (1. your folder) - Point it at a folder and pick the pictures. Press Run once and it sends every picture through the workflow, one after the other. Its filename output carries each picture's name to the save node, and index says which picture it is (1, 2, 3 ...).
  • Number Pixaroma (2. new size in percent) - The new size in percent: 50 = half the size, 200 = twice the size.

 The helpers

Purple. They run by themselves and do the small jobs: count, pick, join or pass things along.

  • Math Expression (new width = a x b / 100) - Works out the new width for EACH picture: round(a * b / 100) = the picture's width x the percent / 100, rounded to whole pixels. a is wired from the folder node's width, b from the percent.
  • Math Expression (new height = a x b / 100) - The same for the height: round(a * b / 100) with the picture's height.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • Upscale Image (resizes to the new width and height) - Resizes each picture to the width and height the Math nodes worked out, with lanczos, the sharpest method.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (3. where and how to save) - Saves the resized pictures as JPG into ComfyUI/output/Scaled; the name gets the new size, like 01_Mug_512x512.jpg.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Show Text Pixaroma (the new widths) - Shows the new widths it worked out, one per picture, so you can check the maths.
  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.
